europe_now.title: EU Proposal for Canada Associate Membership
europe_now.summary: European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen has proposed an associate membership status for Canada, catching several EU capitals by surprise. The initiative aims to position Europe as a leader among global middle powers.

europe_now.title: German Fighter Jets Deployed to Latvia
europe_now.summary: Germany is sending fighter jets to Latvia during the ongoing election period in response to heightened regional drone security threats. The deployment underscores deepening defense cooperation among European allies amid persistent security challenges.

sources.headline: Germany to send fighter jets to Latvia during election amid drone threat

top_stories.title: Regional Security and Drone Incursions
top_stories.summary: Germany announced the deployment of fighter jets to Latvia to provide security support during the electoral period. This measure comes in direct response to increasing security concerns surrounding regional drone incidents.
